text: {"565":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"The destination API server verifies peer connections using its request-header client CA configuration."},"566":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"It specifies certificate authentication configuration for the source and destination API servers."},"567":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"The source API server uses the peer CA file to authenticate the destination server certificate."},"568":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"It defines how kube-apiserver advertises the network location used by peer API servers for proxying."},"569":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"It defines kube-apiserver fallback address settings that peers use for connectivity."}}
